# LocalGroupArchive v0.9.4

Release prepared on 2026-09-28.

This release adds manual Direct Message archiving, keeps automatic archiving limited to new Group DMs, standardizes the English command/status wording, and updates the Windows installer to v0.9.4.

The installer keeps the same application identity and installation location as previous releases, so running v0.9.4 upgrades the existing installation in place. The managed Vencord runtime is backed up before replacement, Discord's original `_app.asar` backup is preserved, and the local archive under `Documents\DiscordLocalArchive` is not removed.
